from pathlib import Path
program_dir=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-high-fresh0/frozen/seen-reference/play/users/u057/system/state/workspace/programs')
program_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
program_path=program_dir/'task-31cb636f.py'
program_text='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    background = Counter(value for row in grid for value in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    marker = next(value for value in Counter(value for row in grid for value in row) if value != background)
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    for r in range(h):
        cols = [c for c, value in enumerate(grid[r]) if value == marker]
        for a, b in zip(cols, cols[1:]):
            for c in range(a + 1, b):
                out[r][c] = 3
    for c in range(w):
        rows = [r for r in range(h) if grid[r][c] == marker]
        for a, b in zip(rows, rows[1:]):
            for r in range(a + 1, b):
                out[r][c] = 3
    return out
'''
